Definition: a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh
BiblicalUsage: Manassites = Manasseh "causing to forget"; 1) descendants of Manasseh, son of Joseph and grandson of Jacob; 1a) specifically used only of that half that lived east of the Jordan
